valuationInputs.name: costOfEquity
valuationInputs.reason: 10-year government bond about 12.4% plus about 5.5 points for a leveraged lender (same as Central Finance); People's Bank parent offsets a fast-growing loan book.

valuationInputs.name: longRunRoe
valuationInputs.reason: Company ROE 7.7–12.7% over five years, 11.3% in 2025/26; rising bad loans limit the upside.

valuationInputs.name: longTermGrowth
valuationInputs.reason: Nominal growth for Sri Lanka, as for other finance companies.

valuationInputs.name: eps2026_27
valuationInputs.reason: H1 group EPS Rs 1.21; impairments rising.

valuationInputs.name: nextDividend
valuationInputs.reason: Rs 1.40 for each of the last three years; the latest in shares.

valuationInputs.name: payoutForResidualIncome
valuationInputs.reason: Payout 60% in 2025/26, 84% in 2024/25; lower as capital is needed for growth.

openQuestions: Why did company Stage 3 loans rise from Rs 5.5bn (March) to Rs 21.0bn (September)? Check the December 2026 interim for a further rise, write-offs or a change in classification rules.
Provision cover on Stage 3 is only about 21%: do impairment charges rise sharply in the second half?
Core capital ratio at September 2026 (not in the interim): how close to the 10% minimum after 75% loan growth?
Is the 2026/27 dividend paid in cash or in shares again?
Group ROE for 2025/26 isn't stated in the reports read; find it in the next annual report.

changeLog.basedOn: Annual Report 2025/26; interims to 30 June and 30 September 2026
changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/add PLC.N00). First analysis. Fair value about half of group NAV because ROE (8–13%) is below an 18% cost of equity; Stage 3 loans jumped to 7.0% in H1 2026/27; 2025/26 dividend paid in shares. Business tests 2 of 4 (weak): avoid for now. Price is the 30 September 2026 close because the CSE feed couldn't be reached.
